_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermal#2. One standalone PROBLEMTYPE: Thermo deck run four times, differing only in the tail of the THERMO element line. 'MAT 1' alone runs to a CORRECT result test (exit 0); appending KINEM linear, TYPE Undefined or THICK 1.0 each aborts with exit 1 and "After parsing, the line still contains '<the token>'." followed by 'Parsed parameters: MAT : 1', from core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec.cpp line 32. The failing runs never reach the result test (KINEM_REACHED_RESULT_TEST=0), so the extra token is rejected outright, not absorbed.
